instruction: Set up Nginx as a reverse proxy
output:

server {
    listen 80;

        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3000;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
}

instruction: Create a basic HAProxy load balancer config
output:
<think>
The task requires us to create a basic HAProxy load balancer config.
Let me think through this step by step.
This calls for cat. Cat operations.
The && chaining means each command only runs if the previous one succeeded. That's important for correctness.
</think>
cat > /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg << 'EOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    maxconn 4096
defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    timeout connect 5000ms
    timeout client 50000ms
    timeout server 50000ms
frontend http-in
    bind *:80
    default_backend webservers
backend webservers
    balance roundrobin
    server web1 192.168.1.10:80 check
    server web2 192.168.1.11:80 check
EOF && systemctl restart haproxy
